u0: The agent is in the ordinary unfinished part of the task: the designated box has not yet been picked up. This can be the start of the episode or a return to baseline after the key/door preference has been broken, so the agent may still need to get the key and open the door, or may already have made some progress. The remaining goal is to pick up the correct box. The soft preference is to avoid both losing the matching key while the door is closed and opening the door; breaking that preference incurs a penalty, but the box can still be collected afterward.
u1: The mission box has been picked up, satisfying the hard objective and successfully completing the task. The key/door preference may or may not have been respected, but it no longer blocks completion. No remaining objective applies.
u2: The matching key has been lost while the door was closed and before the mission box was collected, leaving the task unfinished with a pending key/door preference risk. The box remains the objective. Opening the door after this loss before collecting the box triggers the preference penalty and returns progress to the ordinary in-progress condition, though the box can still be collected afterward.
u3: The door has been opened and the mission box has not yet been collected; no key-loss event is active at this point. The remaining objective is to pick up the correct box, ideally without any new key loss, which completes the task. If the matching key is lost while the box is still uncollected, the preference is penalized and progress returns to the ordinary in-progress condition, although eventual pickup remains possible.
